listeningQuestions.audio: To exercise regularly keeps us fit and healthy.
opts: 有规律地锻炼能使我们保持健康。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is important to eat a balanced diet every day.
opts: 每天吃均衡的饮食很重要。

listeningQuestions.audio: There is no magic pill that will change your bad habits.
opts: 有一种神奇药丸能改掉坏习惯。
没有什么神奇药丸能替你改掉坏习惯。
医生能立刻治好坏习惯。

listeningQuestions.audio: When you feel bored, the cue makes you pick up your phone.
opts: 无聊时,这个信号让你拿起手机。

listeningQuestions.audio: To break a bad habit, keep the same cue but choose a better routine.
opts: 要戒掉坏习惯,保留同样的提示但选更好的常规。
戒习惯要彻底换掉提示。
重复同样的常规就能戒掉习惯。

listeningQuestions.audio: It takes willpower to give up smoking for good.

reading.passage: When George felt stressed, he always relaxed by playing computer games, but afterwards he felt even more worn out. So he replaced gaming with rock climbing, and now he goes climbing with his dad every month. This new habit has improved his health and made him much happier.
reading.passageCn: George 有压力时总爱玩电脑游戏放松,但之后反而更累。于是他用攀岩取代游戏,现在每月和爸爸一起去攀岩。这个新习惯改善了他的健康,也让他开心了许多。

questions.q: How did George feel after playing games?
What did George do to change?
opts: He replaced gaming with rock climbing.

writing.prompt: Write a short note giving a friend advice on how to quit a bad habit and live a healthier life. Say what the habit is, why it is harmful, and how to change it step by step.
writing.promptCn: 写一段话,给朋友一些戒掉坏习惯、过更健康生活的建议:这个习惯是什么、为什么有害、如何一步步改变(试着用不定式作主语:To exercise regularly keeps us fit. / It is important to …)。

lines.text: I really want to stop staying up late on my phone.
lines.cn: 我真的想戒掉熬夜玩手机。

lines.text: To change a habit slowly is easier than stopping all at once.
lines.cn: 慢慢改习惯比一下子戒掉更容易。

lines.text: So what should I do first?
When you feel bored, read a book instead of picking up your phone.
lines.cn: 无聊时,读本书而不是拿手机。

lines.text: I always feel dizzy because I skip breakfast.
lines.cn: 我总因为不吃早餐而头晕。

lines.text: It is important to eat a healthy breakfast every morning.
lines.cn: 每天早上吃顿健康的早餐很重要。

lines.text: But I never have time in the morning.
Just prepare some fruit and nuts the night before.
lines.cn: 前一天晚上准备点水果和坚果就行。
